tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The tenderer should furnish unconditional Line of Credit of Rs.3.05 lakhs in Given format only from any recognised Banks

The tenderer should have achieved in his/Firm name minimum financial turnover of value not less than Rupees 10.17 Lakhs in any two years of the last Five financial years Certified by a Registered Chartered Accountant
The tenderer should have in his or Firm name Registered GST Certificate

The tenderer should have in his/Firm name executed one similar nature of assignment of value not less than Rs 5.08 Lakhs The Tenderer should furnish copy of the Work Done Certificate from any Government Department in Karnataka state only
The Tenderer should have registered at Karnataka Labour Department and Should furnish the Copy of the Valid Registration Certificate
The tenderer should have valid PF and ESI Registration and should furnish the copy
